text.p: SKOPJE, March 28 - These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.

- Greek military planes violated Macedonian air space Thursday morning entering two km (miles) inside its territory at 0945 and leaving at 0946 local time, said the Defence ministry in a press release. One plane flew over the border crossing Bogorodica at very low altitude.
- Anaestheteics finally arrived in the Skopje hospital centre.
- The association of owners of lost deposits in the savings house TAT from Bitola demand international independent institutions to audit and assess real damage.

- According to an opinion poll conducted by Eurobarometer 57 percent of the Macedonians questioned are not satisfied with the development of the democratic processes in the country, 43 percent think the country is moving in a positive direction and the same percentage see the country's future in the European Union and cooperation with the United States. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201196
